items.title: Keep dog on a leash of at most 2 metres outside your own property
items.quote: ordne ich hiermit gemäß § 14 Abs. 1 OBG NRW an, dass Ihr Hund außerhalb Ihres befriedeten Besitztums ab sofort an einer höchstens zwei Meter langen Leine zu führen ist.
items.computation: The order takes effect "ab sofort" (immediately) once the notice is received. Using the same deemed-delivery rule as for the Klage deadline (posting day 15.05.2025 + 4 days for authority post under § 41 Abs. 2 VwVfG, landing on Mon 19.05.2025, which is not a weekend/holiday so no shift), the obligation is already in force from that day. There is no further postponement.

items.title: File Klage (lawsuit) against the leash order at the Verwaltungsgericht
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid kann innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe Klage beim Verwaltungsgericht Musterstadt, Justizzentrum, Gerichtsstraße 5, 44135 Musterstadt, erhoben werden.
items.computation: Posting day is the letter's date, Thu 15.05.2025. Under § 41 Abs. 2 VwVfG an authority letter sent by post counts as delivered on the 4th day after posting, i.e. Mon 19.05.2025 (no weekend/holiday adjustment needed for that day itself). Per § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of delivery is not counted, so the one-month period (§ 188 Abs. 1, 2 BGB) starts Tue 20.05.2025 and would end Thu 19.06.2025. That day is Fronleichnam, a public holiday in NRW, so under § 31 Abs. 3 VwVfG i.V.m. § 57 Abs. 2 VwGO/§ 222 Abs. 2 ZPO the deadline shifts to the next business day, Fri 20.06.2025.

warnings: The letter threatens a Zwangsgeld (coercive fine) of €250 only if the leash order is violated in future; this is not an amount currently due and no payment is being requested now.

No Widerspruch is possible here ("Ein Widerspruchsverfahren findet nicht statt."); only a Klage (lawsuit) at the Verwaltungsgericht can challenge this order, which typically requires legal advice before the deadline.
